capability.description: Find lazy-loaded local Skills, Tools, and MCP capabilities for the current conversation and return selected refs; no arguments. Read provided Skill entry paths directly with read; use capability to discover other Skills. Do not search the filesystem or web for Skills.
guidelines: Many local Tools (such as subagent orchestration), MCP servers, and Skills are lazy-loaded and absent from your active tool list until discovered. Do not assume a capability does not exist just because it is missing from your active tools, and do not treat this tool as another version of tool_search. It will load according to the context when you call this.

Once you understand the task, call capability before starting implementation whenever it involves specialized workflows or formats, external integrations/MCP/browser/UI, background delegation, unfamiliar domains, or any need your current tools do not cover; otherwise proceed directly.
Skills provide workflows, rules, and conventions. Read provided Skill entry paths directly with read; discover other Skills through capability (not filesystem or web searches).

Reuse discovered capabilities throughout the task; call capability again when task requirements shift noticeably and new tools may help, when current tools do not cover the needs, or if you lose track of a Skill's path. For existing tools and MCP, use await describeTool(name) in codemode to inspect parameters, or ALL_TOOLS to list what you have (filtering recommended).

step.label: Capability Step
step.description: Advance discovery by searching with queries, accumulating selected refs, or finishing. All parameters optional.

parameters.queries: Parallel local keyword searches in English. Focus each query on one capability need, using concise action, object, and distinguishing terms. Preserve product/API names. Defaults to []; omit when not searching.
parameters.refs: Exact refs from earlier results. Select namespace refs, not member refs. Selections accumulate; defaults to [].
parameters.finish: Set true to finish discovery. Defaults to false.
